title: Certified Robustness under Heterogeneous Perturbations via Hybrid Randomized Smoothing
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and mathematical certification of robustness for multimodal models (including Large Language Models and Vision-Language Models) against adversarial attacks such as prompt injection. While it uses safety filtering for hateful content as a test case, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as central components of its research.
